description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget named SampleFilesScreen, which provides a UI for users to save a sample PDF to app storage or export it using platform-specific file dialogs. It includes methods for loading assets, saving files, and displaying snackbars to indicate success or failure. The file references external services and Flutter framework components.

classes.name: SampleFilesScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that provides a user interface for saving a sample PDF to app storage or exporting it to a user-visible location. It includes UI elements such as icons, text, and buttons, as well as internal methods for handling file operations and displaying feedback.

methods.name: _saveSamplePdfToAppStorage
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a sample PDF asset, saves it to the app's documents directory, and returns the file path or null on failure.

methods.name: _onSaveToAppStoragePressed
methods.description: Handles the button press to save the sample PDF to app storage, shows a snackbar with success or failure message.

methods.name: _onExportToFilesPressed
methods.description: Handles the button press to export the PDF via the ExportService, and displays the result in a snackbar.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method that constructs the widget tree for the screen, including UI components and interaction callbacks.
